ctx.x: But I could understand. Jimmy had one of the finest books -- band (inaudible). You know, he had a great music book.
That time Wilcox was writing, Sy Oliver (inaudible) things were there, you know, Sy Oliver (inaudible) writing and all that stuff.
And those arrangements were really hard. So anyway, Jimmy sent a telegram to New York to Shoebuck, (inaudible) he would call him (inaudible).
